name: Jim Clyburn
stance: Criticizes President Trump for rejecting AI safeguards and encouraging superintelligence despite warnings of catastrophic harm, and links AI-industry donations to the push to block AI regulation.

statements.text: You cannot read this and think this is a person capable of understanding or caring about the very serious threat AI poses.

The American people should never forget that when they faced exploding costs from a failed war in Iran and dangerous uncertainty from unchecked artificial intelligence, House Republicans decided to cancel work in Washington and go home for nearly eight weeks.
Trump doesn’t want any safeguards on AI because he’s concerned they would cause the stock market to go down under his watch.

Leaders of the world’s largest AI companies are calling for slower development because they fear “superintelligence” could cause catastrophic harm. Trump is openly encouraging it while rejecting new safeguards.
Tens of millions of dollars came from big tech and artificial intelligence companies—the very companies that stand to benefit from Trump’s reckless push to block AI regulation.
